subject: Migration mode selection follow-up - Aurora Health
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 15:05:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap - deployment needs and next steps

Thanks for the call earlier today, Marissa. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying questions so we can move toward procurement: 

- What we covered: Aurora is evaluating migration from OurCurrentAPI (we've been on them for 2yrs) and a mix of self-hosted GPU clusters for internal models. Primary drivers: lower per-token cost, predictable latency for live clinician assistant (P99 < 250ms), and stricter data controls (PHI concerns).
- Expected traffic: ~40 qps peak, average 12 qps. Typical request size ~800 tokens.
- Compliance: HIPAA mandate for PHI, prefer SOC 2 + BAA.
- Deployment preference: we'd like options evaluated — Hosted API for quick start, Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, and Private VPC/on-prem for production PHI workloads.

Questions: 
1) Can you outline the migration path and timeline for each deployment mode (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private)?
2) Do you support a hybrid approach where we use Hosted for non-PHI traffic and Private for PHI?
3) Procurement timeline: we'd like a pricing/quote + SOW by end of month (Aug 31) to start budget approvals.

Appreciate the help — looping in Jamie (security lead) and procurement in case there are doc asks.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Integrations
Aurora Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap - deployment needs and next steps

Thanks Alex — great summary and really helpful context. Recap + proposed next steps below.

High level recommendation (based on today's call):
- Phase 1: Proof-of-concept on Hosted API to validate end-to-end behavior and perf with real traffic (1-2 weeks integration, then 2 weeks of soak). This gets you unblocked quickly and avoids heavy infra work up front.
- Phase 2: Dedicated capacity for clinician assistant workloads where low latency and predictability matter. We can size dedicated GPU pools to meet ~40 qps peak with headroom, and provide autoscale/burst for spikes.
- Phase 3: Private VPC or on-prem for PHI-bound production workloads. We can run the same runtime inside your VPC or an on-prem package; this is typically a 6-10 week project (networking, KMS/HSM integration, SOC2/BAA paperwork).

Hybrid approach: yes — we support splitting traffic by route (non-PHI to Hosted, PHI to Private). Smart routing/fallback will keep the app online during capacity events.

Attachments I'm sending with this email: redwood-deployment-options.pdf (deployment patterns and timelines), SOC2-Attestation-2027.pdf, and a draft Aurora_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Schedule technical deep dive with Marcus + Dylan this week to validate sizing and network requirements (Marcus: optional; Dylan: networking + infra).
2) We'll produce a formal quote + SOW by Aug 24 so procurement has time before your Aug 31 internal deadline.
3) Jamie / security: if you can share any specific questionnaire items or the RFP doc, we’ll start filling them out ASAP.

Marcus / Dylan — can you confirm availability for a 60-min deep dive on Wed or Thu this week?

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0133

Attachments: redwood-deployment-options.pdf; SOC2-Attestation-2027.pdf; Aurora_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap - deployment needs and next steps

Adding a few technical items ahead of the deep dive:

Marissa — Wed/Thu works for me; I can do Thu 10-11am PT. Dylan — can you join for networking and private deployment sizing?

Alex / Jamie — a couple of inputs that will help our sizing and cost comparison: 
- Do you have 95th/99th percentile request size distribution and a few sample prompts? That helps pick model variants and batching configs.
- Do you expect sustained multitenant traffic across multiple app routes or a small number of high-throughput routes?
- Any latency SLOs by route (you mentioned P99 < 250ms for clinician assistant — are there other critical routes)?

Preliminary sizing notes for context (ballpark):
- For 40 qps peak with ~800 token requests, running with quantized open models on Dedicated, estimate: 2-3 A100-equivalent GPUs with continuous batching and KV cache. If you want headroom + autoscale, plan for 4 GPUs in the pool.
- Private VPC/on-prem: similar footprint but adds networking overhead and RTO for failover; we’ll need to test WAN egress and KMS latency.

I’ll prepare a short cost comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and share before the deep dive so we can walk numbers.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

(Internal note: Dylan, please bring template network checklist and expected firewall rules.)
